name: chelsea_market
description: Let's picnic on the High Line, grab some delights from the market and we'll people-watch from our cozy blanket nestled on a small patch of nature surrounded in the bustle of the city as it ages gracefully. Enjoy the quirky bohemian feel of Chelsea Market and use it often.
